verdict.rationale: Mailgun has no native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The only scheduling evidence comes through external tools: the documented n8n integration says it can "send, schedule, and track emails," and GitHub Actions workflows can trigger sends. Send-time optimization is a delivery feature, not recurring job scheduling. Missing for 10: native recurring job/workflow scheduling in Mailgun, documented recurrence (cron-style) configuration, scheduling exposed via API/MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
